summary: Each repo keeps its own area list in a config ref, with a skill that helps set it up
riskReason: Changing a repo's list can make its existing intents invalid until their areas are edited.

add.type: config ref whose tree holds the area list

add.signature: (repo, areas) => ids of intents the new list leaves invalid

change.to: areas from the repo's list, defaulting to fe, be, db, infra

rules.text: the config is written only through the CLI, as an event commit, like plans
scripts/github.sh pushes and fetches the config ref along with the plans
a setup skill looks at the repo's layout, proposes an area list, and asks the human to confirm it before writing it
set-areas rejects an empty list, names that aren't short lowercase words, and duplicates, and names every intent the new list leaves invalid

evidence: an intent using an area outside its repo's list is rejected
a repo without a config accepts the default four
the config ref round-trips through github.sh push and pull
